name: Ken
subject: I
intro: Let's guess Ken's free time again! You are Ken. Listen to my question and choose your answer.
question: What do you do in your free time?

items.context: Today is Monday. It's rainy after school.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I ride a bike in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
I play the recorder in my free time.
items.zh: 下雨天放學，Ken 走路回家，在房間練直笛。

items.context: It's Monday evening. It's cold and windy.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I surf the Internet in my free time.
I play baseball in my free time.
I go camping in my free time.
items.zh: 晚上又冷又有風，Ken 在家用電腦上網。

items.context: Today is Tuesday. It's sunny and windy. Time to go to school.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I watch TV in my free time.
I ride a bike in my free time.
I play online games in my free time.
items.zh: 早上迎著風，Ken 騎腳踏車上學。

items.context: It's Tuesday afternoon. School is over. It's sunny.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I play basketball in my free time.
I go camping in my free time.
I surf the Internet in my free time.
items.zh: 放學後天氣晴朗，Ken 留在學校旁投籃。

items.context: It's Wednesday evening. It's rainy outside.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I go jogging in my free time.
I play baseball in my free time.
I watch TV in my free time.
items.zh: 下雨的晚上，Ken 坐在沙發上看電視。

items.context: Today is Thursday. School is over. It's cold and rainy.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I go camping in my free time.
I study English in my free time.
I go jogging in my free time.
items.zh: 又冷又下雨，Ken 放學走路回家，坐在書桌前讀英文。

items.context: It's Friday evening. It's cool. The sky is clear.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I play baseball in my free time.
I go camping in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
items.zh: 星期五晚上天空很清，Ken 和家人走到水心之初大草原搭帳篷露營。

items.context: Today is Saturday. It's a warm, sunny morning.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I play baseball in my free time.
I surf the Internet in my free time.
I play the recorder in my free time.
items.zh: 露營隔天早上，爸爸在大草原投球，Ken 揮棒打棒球。

items.context: It's Saturday afternoon. It's very hot.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I go jogging in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
I listen to music in my free time.
items.zh: 下午太熱了，Ken 走回家，戴耳機聽音樂。

items.context: Today is Sunday. It's a cool, sunny morning.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I go jogging in my free time.
I study English in my free time.
I play online games in my free time.
items.zh: 星期天清爽的早晨，Ken 從家裡沿街慢跑到八堡圳公園。

items.context: It's Sunday evening. It's dark and cold.
items.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: I ride a bike in my free time.
I play online games in my free time.
I play basketball in my free time.
items.zh: 星期天晚上又黑又冷，Ken 在家玩線上遊戲。
